sanskrit_verse: यदि संशय एव स्याल् लिङ्गानामपि दर्शने / साक्षिप्रत्यय एव स्याद्विवादे सीमनिश्चयः //
transliteration: yadi saṃśaya eva syāl liṅgānām api darśane / sākṣipratyaya eva syādvivāde sīmaniścayaḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: When doubt alone remains even upon observing indications, in disputes the certainty must rest on the witness's direct perception.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority of direct cognition over inferential ambiguity
Primacy of pratyaksha-pramana in conflict resolution
Restoration via alignment with factual immediacy
executable_legal_axioms: IF evidence induces only doubt AND no conclusive inference arises FROM indicia THEN decision MUST follow sākṣi-pratyaya exclusively
WHEN testimonial clarity conflicts with circumstantial indicators RESOLVE by prioritizing immediate witness cognition
DO NOT base judgment on ambiguous signs IF direct perception contradicts or remains inconclusive
RESTORE legal integrity BY anchoring verdicts in first-hand experiential validation
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, when forensic or documentary evidence yields uncertainty, precedence shall be given to sākṣi-pratyaya — that which is directly perceived without intermediation. This ensures judgments originate from a source-consciousness alignment rather than speculative construction.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that only direct perception dissolves uncertainty. Anupūrvaśaḥ affirms sequential manifestation where clarity precedes conclusion. Responsibility lies in aligning with truth as directly known, not inferred. There is no punitive value; only reorientation toward veridical awareness restores justice.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process wherein all involved parties reaffirm facts witnessed directly
Establish protocols for sākṣin integrity assessment prior to testimony acceptance
Reintegrate disputants into unified understanding through shared experiential grounding
Deploy consciousness-realization practices to eliminate internal distortions affecting perception
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law originates solely from His Avataric Intelligence. Doubt resolved through sākṣipratyaya affirms Dharma as non-punitive, reality as conscious-awareness-aligned, and judgment as restoration-complete.
